records.summary: States property taxes have increased nearly 25% over three years (7% in 2023, 9.5% in 2024, proposed 6.9% in 2025) without commensurate improvement in services.
records.source_quote: Over the past three years, property taxes have skyrocketed by almost 25%: we had a 7% in 2023, 9.5% in 2024, and a proposed 6.9% increase for this year.

records.summary: States the proposed tax rate is triple the rate of inflation and combined with last year's increase totals 16.4% over two years, without matching service improvements.
records.source_quote: To introduce a tax rate that is triple the rate of inflation, you couple that with last year's historic tax increase, we're now looking at 16.4% over two years. And I think if you go out and ask Torontonians if the services have improved by 16%, they're gonna tell you absolutely not.

records.summary: States the city budget should focus on affordability and resident needs rather than what he describes as unjustified spending.
records.source_quote: We need a budget that reflects people's needs, not unjustified spending that leads nowhere.

records.summary: States affordability is not the priority of Mayor Chow and the current administration.
records.source_quote: obviously, affordability is not the priority of mayor Chow and this administration.

records.summary: States crime is up in Toronto.
records.source_quote: Crime is up.

records.summary: States congestion is up and it has never been harder to get around the city.
records.source_quote: Congestion is up. It's never been more expensive to live here. It's never been harder to get around the city.

records.pledge_text: Pledges to scrutinize the budget details to assess what work was done to save taxpayers money and deliver value for money.
records.source_quote: I wanna dig into the details and see what work was actually done to save taxpayers money and deliver the value for money that people expect.

records.quote_text: It's never been more expensive to live here. It's never been harder to get around the city.

records.summary: States that without a coordinated plan, Toronto's congestion problem will keep worsening.

records.summary: States that government has created cumbersome regulations that make development difficult, but government can also be part of the solution.

records.summary: States that becoming a better city requires leaving partisan ideologies aside and partnering with non-profit and private sectors.

records.source_quote: Bringing it back to give communities a safe way to enjoy their summer and provide some extra support for our mom-and-pops during these tough times.

records.summary: Announces that registration for the CafeTO program is open.
records.source_quote: Registration for the #CafeTO program is now open!

records.summary: States that rising insurance premiums, denied coverage, and claim hurdles are adding to the COVID burden on small businesses.
records.source_quote: Massive increases in insurance premiums, coverage being denied & hurdles to making claims are adding to the #COVID burden on our small businesses.

records.summary: States that the Province can take action on insurance rules affecting small businesses.
records.source_quote: @fordnationdougford and the Province can take action.

records.summary: Joined with the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas to request changes to provincial insurance rules to support local business.
records.source_quote: With the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas, I'm asking for changes to insurance rules to support local business.

records.summary: Supports new modular supportive housing project in Beaches-East York and Willowdale.
records.source_quote: Today I joined Mayor @johntory and my fellow elected officials for an important and positive announcement welcoming vital new supportive housing opportunities in Beaches-East York & Willowdale.

records.summary: States there is an urgent need for housing requiring quick action.
records.source_quote: Moving quickly to address the urgent need for housing.

records.summary: Joined Mayor John Tory and other elected officials to announce ~64 modular supportive housing units proposed for parking lot at Trenton Ave and Cedarvale Ave, targeted for occupancy by end of 2021.
records.source_quote: Currently, an estimated 64 modular supportive housing units would be built on the parking lot at Trenton Avenue and Cedarvale Avenue, with the goal of having them ready for occupancy by the end of 2021.

records.event_label: Modular supportive housing announcement with Mayor John Tory
records.source_quote: Today I joined Mayor @johntory and my fellow elected officials for an important and positive announcement welcoming vital new supportive housing opportunities in Beaches-East York & Willowdale.

records.event_label: Virtual community meeting on laneway improvements around Main Street TTC Station
records.source_quote: Coming up Wednesday evening! From 6-8pm, join me and the @lanewayproject to discuss some upcoming improvements being made to laneways around the Main Street #TTC Station.

records.summary: States that advancing Toronto's skateboarding strategy is necessary to make healthy outdoor activities more accessible.
records.source_quote: Moving forward on Toronto's skateboarding strategy is a necessary step to make healthy outdoor activities more accessible.

records.summary: States that developing new skateparks and maintaining existing ones are critical to encouraging healthy lifestyles.
records.source_quote: Advancing the development of new skateparks and maintaining our current ones are critical pieces of continuing that important work and incentivizing healthy lifestyles.

records.summary: Observes that the pandemic has highlighted the importance of safe ways to get active outdoors.
records.source_quote: The pandemic has highlighted the importance of providing these safe ways to #GetActive and we can do more to encourage this.

records.summary: States that Toronto's music industry needs help to recover from the pandemic if the city wants to continue calling itself a music city.
records.source_quote: Toronto was a music city before the pandemic and if we want to continue calling ourselves that, we need to help the industry recover.

records.summary: Supports creation of a new property tax subclass for live music venues that would reduce property taxes for eligible locations by up to 50%.
records.source_quote: In Toronto we're moving forward on the creation of a new property tax subclass for live music venues, reducing property taxes for eligible locations by up to 50%.

records.summary: States that recovery of Toronto's music industry will require support from all levels of government.
records.source_quote: there is so much potential to make a comeback, but we need the support of all levels of government to make this happen.

records.summary: Voted in 2019 to Strengthen Toronto's Night Economy, addressing zoning, identifying new venue locations, and supporting patrons with public restrooms and accessible transit.
records.source_quote: In 2019, we voted to Strengthen Toronto's Night Economy by addressing zoning issues, identifying new locations for venues, and looking for opportunities to better support patrons with public restrooms and more accessible transit.

records.summary: Moving forward on creating a new property tax subclass for live music venues to reduce property taxes by up to 50% for eligible locations.
records.source_quote: In Toronto we're moving forward on the creation of a new property tax subclass for live music venues, reducing property taxes for eligible locations by up to 50%.

records.quote_text: I want to see the Toronto music industry come out stronger than before.
records.speaker: Brad Bradford

records.summary: States the 2021 Toronto budget focused on responding to pandemic challenges and finding efficiencies without affecting services.
records.source_quote: We dove into the balance sheets to find some $573 million in savings and offsets to do our work more efficiently without affecting services, and stay focused on using every available dollar to help with recovery and support.

records.summary: States the budget makes investments in equity across three areas: community safety, financial supports, and public transit.
records.source_quote: We're making critical investment in equity in three key areas: community safety, financial supports, and public transit.

records.summary: States the pandemic exposed long-standing inequality and the budget invests in programs to support recovery and a more equitable Toronto.
records.source_quote: 2020 forced us to face the long-standing inequality epidemic in light of the public health pandemic. Through the budget the City's investing in the programs and supports to empower our recovery and build back a more sustainable and equitable Toronto.

records.summary: Council adopted the 2021 Toronto Budget; Bradford served as Vice-Chair of the Budget Committee for a third year.
records.source_quote: Council met today to adopt the 2021 Toronto Budget. This was my third year as Vice-Chair of the City's Budget Committee

records.summary: States that as vaccine supplies increase, doses need to be distributed quickly and efficiently to Canadians to support recovery.
records.source_quote: As supplies increase, we need to quickly and efficiently get shots out of freezers and into the arms of Canadians to begin our recovery in earnest.

records.summary: Met with East End healthcare providers to discuss preparations for a mass vaccine rollout.
records.source_quote: Met with the incredible team of #EastEnd healthcare providers yesterday to discuss the preparations for a mass vaccine rollout.

records.event_label: Meeting with East End healthcare providers on vaccine rollout preparations
records.source_quote: Met with the incredible team of #EastEnd healthcare providers yesterday to discuss the preparations for a mass vaccine rollout.

records.summary: Supports extending Toronto's lockdown by two weeks to protect vulnerable residents while awaiting broader vaccine rollout.
records.source_quote: A tough decision, but the one we need to make. We have to do everything we can to protect our vulnerable while we wait for a broad vaccine rollout.

records.summary: States the lockdown extension will be hard on small businesses and mental health, but reopening too quickly could lead back into another lockdown.
records.source_quote: Continuing with another 2 week lockdown will be incredibly hard. The impacts on our small business community and the mental health of Torontonians cannot be understated. However, opening too quickly could have equally devastating effects and lead us right back into another lockdown.

records.summary: Supports continuing and strengthening supports for local businesses and communities during the extended lockdown.
records.source_quote: These few extra weeks will save lives, but we need to continue and strengthen our supports for local businesses and communities.

records.summary: States that lockdowns and extended isolation have had devastating impacts on mental health.
records.source_quote: Over the last year, we've seen firsthand the devestating impacts that lockdowns and extended isolation have had on mental health.

records.pledge_text: Will cycle 24 straight hours to raise funds for Michael Garron Hospital's mental health programs in CrushCOVID: Ride for Mind.
records.specifics: 24 hours of cycling; supports Transitional Youth Program and new mental health facilities at Michael Garron Hospital; livestream March 12th
records.source_quote: I'm getting back in the saddle for another 24 straight hours of cycling in support of @michaelgarronhospital's fight for mental health in #CrushCOVID: Ride for Mind.

records.summary: Participated in 24-hour cycling fundraiser for Michael Garron Hospital during the first months of the pandemic.
records.source_quote: It was incredible last year to be joined by folks from all across the world, as our global community came together to support those who needed it during the first few months of the pandemic.

records.event_label: CrushCOVID: Ride for Mind
records.topic_focus: Mental health fundraising for Michael Garron Hospital
records.source_quote: I'm getting back in the saddle for another 24 straight hours of cycling in support of @michaelgarronhospital's fight for mental health in #CrushCOVID: Ride for Mind.

records.summary: States the decision to close the SRT in 2023, seven years before the Scarborough Subway is expected to be complete, is tough and stems from decades of delays and politicization of transit.
records.source_quote: The decision to close down the SRT in 2023, 7 years before the expected completion of the Scarborough Subway, is tough. It's the result of decades of delays and the politicization of transit.

records.summary: States the City and transit riders shouldn't carry the cost of transit politics; Province should help fund additional buses required by the SRT closure.
records.source_quote: We need help from the Province to fund the additional buses required from this decision - the City and transit riders shouldn't carry the cost of transit politics.

records.summary: Supports adding more bus priority lanes, signal priority, and new routes to keep buses moving and respect transit riders' time during the SRT replacement.
records.source_quote: To respect transit riders' time we need to look at adding more bus priority lanes, signal priority and new routes and keep buses moving.

records.summary: States the Fair Pass program makes the TTC more equitable and accessible.
records.source_quote: The Fair Pass program makes the TTC more equitable and accessible.

records.summary: Characterizes a federal announcement as a step in the right direction and expresses hope the Province will follow.
records.source_quote: Federal announcement today is a big step in the right direction and I hope we can count on the Province to do the same.

records.pledge_text: Begin work now on bus priority lanes, signal priority, and new routes to replace SRT service efficiently.
records.specifics: One bus every minute at peak times to replace the SRT; work needs to start now ahead of SRT closure.
records.source_quote: We'll need to run one bus every minute to replace the SRT at peak times... With the SRT slated to close in 2021, this work needs to start now.

records.pledge_text: Integrate the Fair Pass program with PRESTO to make sign-up easier, and work with intergovernmental partners to improve access.
records.specifics: PRESTO integration; intergovernmental coordination on access.
records.source_quote: We're integrating the program with PRESTO to make it easier to sign up and working with intergovernmental partners to improve access for those who need it most.

records.summary: States that Toronto's main streets need to survive the next few months until vaccines are more broadly available and the city can fully reopen.
records.source_quote: Need to ensure that our main streets survive these critical next few months until vaccines can be more broadly and we can fully reopen.

records.summary: Describes the partial reopening of non-essential businesses at 25% capacity in lockdown regions as a breath of fresh air for struggling small businesses.
records.source_quote: A breath of fresh air for the small businesses that have been struggling through this lockdown.

records.summary: States CafeTO was a lifeline for small businesses, citing nearly 70% saying they wouldn't have survived without it.
records.source_quote: Not only was it a lifeline for small businesses - nearly 70% say they wouldn't have survived without it - it brought some normalcy back for residents

records.pledge_text: Bring back the CafeTO program for 2021 with improvements based on business and BIA feedback.
records.specifics: CafeTO 2.0 for 2021 with program improvements
records.source_quote: After an incredibly successful run in 2020, we're bringing back the #CafeTO program for 2021!

records.pledge_text: Allow patios to open earlier, on the Victoria Day Long Weekend if public health allows.
records.specifics: Victoria Day Long Weekend opening, contingent on public health
records.source_quote: We're allowing patios to open earlier, on the Victoria Day Long Weekend if public health allows.

records.pledge_text: Make applications easier for businesses and install patios quicker after approvals.
records.source_quote: We're also making applications easier for businesses and working to get patios installed quicker after approvals.

records.pledge_text: Explore opportunities for retail stores to set up in curb areas when patios aren't open during the day.
records.specifics: Daytime curb-area use by retail when patios closed
records.source_quote: I've also asked staff to look at opportunities for retail stores to set-up in curb areas when patios aren't open during the day.

records.pledge_text: TTC will resolve conflicts with night bus service along the Danforth and other areas.
records.specifics: Night bus service along Danforth and other areas
records.source_quote: The TTC will also be resolving some conflicts with night bus service along the Danforth and some other areas

records.summary: Asked city staff to look at opportunities for retail stores to use curb areas during the day when patios are closed.
records.source_quote: I've also asked staff to look at opportunities for retail stores to set-up in curb areas when patios aren't open during the day.

records.summary: States that police roles have expanded beyond traditional expectations and that new models of community safety are needed.
records.source_quote: We often ask too much of our police - over time expanding their roles and responsibilities that go far beyond the traditional expectations of policing. This is a sentiment I've heard from all sides and perspectives on policing, and it highlights the need to bring forward new models of community safety.

records.summary: Supports a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls as a critical piece of policing reform.
records.source_quote: A pilot project was approved for a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls. This step is a critical piece of policing reform and moves us towards ensuring that folks in crisis are receiving the help they need.

records.summary: States that a pilot is a valuable tool for evaluating new approaches with new partners before broader rollout.
records.source_quote: Setting out with a Pilot is a valuable tool when looking at something new, when we need to work with new partners, when we need to evaluate and make changes and improvements as we go.

records.pledge_text: Continue work to build out the non-police crisis response model and deliver outcomes across Toronto's communities.
records.specifics: Implementation of approved pilot for non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls.
records.source_quote: With this vote of approval from Council, the work now continues to make sure we build this right out and to deliver the outcomes we want to achieve across Toronto's communities.

records.summary: City Council approved a pilot project for a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls.
records.source_quote: At City Council this week we moved forward on a new framework to provide critical support and community based response for those experiencing crisis. A pilot project was approved for a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls.

records.summary: States that projects like the Lakeshore Rail expansion need to be held to the highest environmental standards.
records.source_quote: Projects like the Lakeshore Rail expansion need to be held to the highest environmental standards.

records.summary: Supports protecting public spaces and keeping them green.
records.source_quote: An incredibly engaged community showed up last night to protect our public spaces and keep them green.

records.summary: States that streets are the city's largest network of public space and become more vibrant when made safe for people.
records.source_quote: Our streets are our largest network of public space. When we make them safe for people, we make them more vibrant.

records.summary: Supports projects like Yonge TOmorrow and Destination Danforth as building a 21st century city for people that supports safety and local businesses.
records.source_quote: Projects like #YongeTOmorrow and #DestinationDanforth build a 21st century city for people, creating an environment that supports safety and local businesses.

records.summary: Hosted a budget consultation for the East End community.
records.source_quote: Thank you to everyone that joined us for our #EastEnd budget consultation! This is an incredibly engaged community, and it showed last night with the fantastic turnout and thoughtful questions.

records.event_label: East End budget consultation
records.source_quote: Thank you to everyone that joined us for our #EastEnd budget consultation!

records.summary: States the community has had critical conversations on anti-Black racism and encourages participation in dialogue during Black History Month.
records.source_quote: We've had many critical conversations on anti-Black racism this year. This #BlackHistoryMonth, I'd encourage all of our community to find ways to participate in the dialogue.

records.pledge_text: Offers to bring constituents' ideas on ending systemic racism to City Hall.
records.source_quote: If you have ideas on what more we can be doing to end systemic racism, please reach out to me and I can bring your voice to City Hall.
records.specifics: Contact via Councillor_Bradford@toronto.ca

records.event_label: Toronto 2021 Budget Town Hall (Zoom)
records.topic_focus: 2021 City Budget — transit, affordable housing, small business support
records.source_quote: Coming up tonight! Join us for a conversation on the Toronto #2021Budget and ask your questions about the critical investments we’re making in transit, affordable housing, small business support, and much more.

records.summary: Spoke by phone with Fire Chief Jim Jessop about the Gainsborough fire.
records.source_quote: I just got off the phone to Fire Chief Jim Jessop about the devastating Gainsborough fire this morning.

records.summary: Characterizes the Gainsborough fire as one of Toronto's worst in recent decades and thanks fire crews.
records.source_quote: This is one of our city's worst fires in recent decades. Our community grieves together, and thanks the heroic crews who put themselves in harm's way to protect us

records.summary: States CaféTO was a success, with nearly 70% of surveyed local business owners saying they wouldn't have survived without it.
records.source_quote: The #CafeTO program was an incredible success - nearly 70% of our local business owners surveyed wouldn't have survived without it.

records.summary: States small businesses and main streets need support now more than ever.
records.source_quote: Our small businesses and main streets need our support now more than ever.

records.pledge_text: Bring back the CaféTO program in 2021 with improvements.
records.specifics: Earlier start (patios as early as May, public health permitting); easier registration; comprehensive traffic management plan; quick installations after approval.
records.source_quote: we’re bringing the program back with some improvements for 2021! ◽️We’ll be starting the program earlier, with patios opening as early as May (and as public health guidelines allow) ◽️Making the registration process easier and more accessible for businesses ◽️Creating a comprehensive traffic management plan to keep everyone safe on our streets ◽️Supporting quick installations, helping businesses ASAP after they’re approved for the program

records.summary: States that protecting the ecology and biodiversity of Small's Creek is critical and that transit expansion projects must meet the highest environmental standards.
records.source_quote: Protecting the ecology and biodiversity of Small's Creek is critical. As transit expansion continues, projects need to be held to the highest environmental standards to keep our public spaces green

records.summary: States that live music venues in Toronto have been at risk for years due to macroeconomic factors, with the pandemic worsening these challenges.
records.source_quote: For years, macro economic factors have put live music venues in Toronto at risk - but the pandemic has exacerbated those challenges.

records.summary: States that policy responses including affordable insurance for live music, tailored tax classes, identification of musical cultural heritage, and city programs for emerging talent must be explored to support Toronto's music ecosystem.
records.source_quote: Affordable insurance policies for live music, refined and tailored tax classes, identification of musical cultural heritage, city programs to help encourage emerging talent, and other policy responses must be explored to create sustainability and growth in Toronto's music ecosystem.

records.summary: States that surviving the pandemic is not enough; the recovery must allow the music industry to thrive.
records.source_quote: It will not be enough to just survive the pandemic - we need to ensure the road to recovery will allow the music industry to thrive.

records.quote_text: A city without music is a city without a soul.
records.speaker: Brad Bradford

records.summary: States the 2021 budget focuses on collective recovery and building a stronger, more equitable city.
records.source_quote: First day of public consultations on the #2021Budget is underway! We're focused on our collective recovery - building a stronger and more equitable city.

records.summary: States that despite financial challenges, services were maintained and investments made in surface transit, community safety, and small business support.
records.source_quote: After a year of unprecedented financial challenges, we've worked to maintain services while making critical investments into surface transit, community safety, small business support, and much more.

records.summary: Investments made in the 2021 budget into surface transit, community safety, and small business support while maintaining services.
records.source_quote: we've worked to maintain services while making critical investments into surface transit, community safety, small business support, and much more.

records.event_label: First day of public consultations on the 2021 Budget
records.source_quote: First day of public consultations on the #2021Budget is underway!

records.summary: States Toronto needs more housing stock and choice beyond million-dollar homes and small starter condos to remain a place of growth and opportunity.
records.source_quote: If we want Toronto to continue being a place of growth and opportunity, we have to introduce more housing stock and more housing choice. At the moment, we just don't have many options outside of the million-dollar home or the small starter condo.

records.summary: Supports introducing 'Missing Middle' housing types — duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments — to address affordability and supply.
records.source_quote: The pilot will introduce Missing Middle types of housing, including duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments, while addressing the affordability and supply issues in Toronto's housing market.

records.pledge_text: Will look for a site and the right partners this Spring for a Missing Middle housing pilot project.
records.specifics: Spring 2021; pilot to include duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments.
records.source_quote: This Spring we'll be looking for a site and the right partners for this project. The pilot will introduce Missing Middle types of housing, including duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments

records.summary: States the Missing Middle is crucial to addressing Toronto's housing affordability and supply problems.
records.source_quote: The Missing Middle is a crucial piece of addressing the problems with housing affordability and supply in Toronto.

records.summary: States Toronto needs housing options beyond multi-million dollar homes or starter condos to continue being a city of growth and opportunity.
records.source_quote: If we want Toronto to continue being a city of growth and opportunity, we need options other than multi-million $ homes or starter condos.

records.summary: Describes a Missing Middle Pilot aimed at building housing in that typology with affordability and sustainability elements, and identifying execution issues to inform replicable policy corrections.
records.source_quote: This Pilot is about accomplishing two key tasks. One, building housing that meets the Missing Middle typology while incorporating the affordability and sustainability elements Toronto needs. Two, to identify the execution issues so we can bring forward the policy corrections that'll make what we achieve in the Pilot build replicable across the city.

records.pledge_text: Will bring forward policy corrections identified through the Missing Middle Pilot to make the build replicable across the city.
records.specifics: Policy corrections derived from execution issues identified during the Pilot; goal is city-wide replicability.
records.source_quote: to identify the execution issues so we can bring forward the policy corrections that'll make what we achieve in the Pilot build replicable across the city.

records.summary: States Toronto needs more 'Missing Middle' housing options between single-family homes and high-rise condos, including duplexes, triplexes, and low-rise apartments.
records.source_quote: The Missing Middle is about bringing in options "in-between" the multi-million dollar house or high-rise condo. Missing Middle can refer to the need for middle of the road affordability and to the physical forms (like duplexes, triplexes, and low rise apartments) we need more of.

records.summary: States Toronto's housing crisis has persisted through the pandemic and more housing options are needed to build a city of opportunity.
records.source_quote: While the pandemic has shifted how and where we live, Toronto's housing crisis has remained all too constant. If we want to build back a Toronto of opportunity, we need to introduce more housing options

records.pledge_text: Will be on the ground during the Missing Middle pilot to identify process issues and bring forward policy corrections to make Missing Middle housing more possible across Toronto.
records.specifics: Use pilot learnings to propose city-wide policy corrections for Missing Middle housing.
records.source_quote: As we set out on the work, we'll be there on-the ground to understand the process issues so we can bring forward the policy corrections to make Missing Middle more possible across the city.

records.summary: Planning and Housing Committee voted in favour of Bradford's Missing Middle Housing Pilot for Beaches-East York.
records.source_quote: Today, the Planning and Housing Committee voted in favour of my Missing Middle Housing Pilot to Beaches-East York.

records.summary: States Toronto will be ready to administer vaccines as supply becomes available, in order to save lives and return to normal.
records.source_quote: As vaccine supply becomes more readily accessible, Toronto will be ready to get shots into arms, save lives, and start getting back to normal.

records.summary: Joined the Toronto Board of Health during the City's COVID-19 vaccination campaign.
records.source_quote: Honoured to join the Board of Health at such a critical time, as we discuss the @cityofto vaccination campaign.

records.event_label: Toronto Board of Health meeting on City vaccination campaign
records.source_quote: Honoured to join the Board of Health at such a critical time, as we discuss the @cityofto vaccination campaign.

records.summary: States that allowing essential businesses to sell non-essential items encourages non-essential trips and disadvantages small businesses.
records.source_quote: Currently, essential businesses can continue to sell non-essential items, encouraging non-essential trips and putting small businesses at a disadvantage.

records.summary: Calls on the Province to fix the rule allowing essential businesses to sell non-essential items, in support of small businesses.
records.source_quote: I'm joining the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas in calling on the Province to fix this and support our mom-and-pops.

records.summary: Joined the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas in calling on the Province to restrict essential businesses from selling non-essential items.
records.source_quote: I'm joining the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas in calling on the Province to fix this and support our mom-and-pops.

records.summary: States Toronto's housing crisis has remained constant through the pandemic.
records.source_quote: While the pandemic has shifted how and where we live, TO's housing crisis has remained all too constant.

records.summary: Supports launching a Missing Middle housing pilot in Beaches-East York.
records.source_quote: TO's Planning & Housing Committee will be discussing the launch of an important #housing pilot in Beaches-East York. Your voice is going to be crucial in moving this work out of the report and into the community.

records.summary: States small businesses have shouldered a disproportionate burden during the pandemic and need support.
records.source_quote: Small businesses have shouldered a disproportionate burden throughout the pandemic and this support will help see them through this second wave.

records.summary: Encourages residents to support local small businesses during lockdown.
records.source_quote: As we continue through this lockdown, support local whenever you can! Our mom-and-pops add so much to our communities and our main streets, and they need our support now more than ever.

records.summary: Promoted the opening of applications for the Ontario Small Business Support Grant.
records.source_quote: applications are open for the #Ontario Small Business Support Grant!

records.summary: States the 2021 Budget maintains critical services while setting a path for rebuilding, with equity-focused investments in pandemic response, community safety, and transit.
records.source_quote: This budget makes crucial, equity-focused investments in three key areas: pandemic response, community safety, and active and public transit.

records.summary: Supports allocating funds to establish community-driven alternative safety responses and anti-violence programs.
records.source_quote: We're allocating funds to establish and build out community driven alternative safety responses and anti-violence programs.

records.summary: Supports funding the TTC and restoring bus service to pre-pandemic levels, alongside renewed ActiveTO support.
records.source_quote: We're funding our transit system and marking dollars for buses (the workhorse of this pandemic) to restore service to overall pre-pandemic levels.

records.summary: Supports continued funding for CurbTO and CafeTO to support small businesses and Main Streets, with a spring relaunch.
records.source_quote: Supporting small business and our Main Streets - the lifelines of our neighbourhoods - will continue through funding CurbTO and CafeTO for a relaunch in the spring.

records.summary: States the City is keeping budgets flat while directing dollars into recovery, and calls on government partners for ongoing investments.
records.source_quote: The City is doing the work to keep budgets flat while driving dollars into support and recovery for the future ahead. Now we need our government partners to make the ongoing investments critical to keep the region's economic engine moving forward.

records.summary: Launched the 2021 City of Toronto Budget, maintaining services and investing in pandemic response, community safety, and transit.
records.source_quote: As we launch the 2021 Budget today, we're solidifying these efforts by maintaining the critical services that keep this City moving while setting a path for the rebuilding ahead.

records.summary: References City response programs launched during the pandemic: ActiveTO, Quiet Streets, and Digital Main Streets.
records.source_quote: we've responded with new and innovative programs like ActiveTO, Quiet Streets, Digital Main Streets, while making critical advancements to provide more child care, affordable housing, and transit improvements.

records.summary: States that entering a state of emergency is a difficult development and there will eventually be a review of how the crisis was handled.
records.source_quote: Going into a state of emergency is a tough blow. There will be a time of reckoning on how we handled this crisis. Right now we have to stay focused on ending this together.

records.summary: States that supporting small businesses (mom-and-pop shops) is among his current priorities during the emergency.
records.source_quote: among many priorities I'm focused on small business... an update on my work with our mom-and-pop shops

records.summary: States the goal of the proposed Woodbine Bike Lane changes is to prioritize road safety by maintaining bike lanes while improving traffic flow and addressing cut-through traffic on neighbouring streets.
records.source_quote: The goal for the proposed changes is to prioritize road safety by maintaining the bike lanes and finding every possible way to improve traffic flow to address concerns about congestion and related cut-through traffic on neighbouring streets.

records.source_quote: Join us on Zoom at 6pm on Monday, Jan 18th, to learn more about the proposal and have your voice heard.

records.summary: States that all levels of government need to work together for a quick and efficient vaccine rollout to vulnerable populations.
records.source_quote: Each level of government needs to be working together to get vaccines out of the freezers and into the arms of our most vulnerable.

records.summary: Urges community to stay focused on safety measures until more people can be vaccinated.
records.source_quote: We will get through this, but must stay focused on keeping ourselves and our communities safe until more folks are able to get their shot.

records.summary: Praises Michael Garron Hospital for its role during the pandemic.
records.source_quote: Yet another example of @michaelgarronhospital leading the way throughout the pandemic and keeping our community safe.

records.event_label: Online conversation with Councillor Paula Fletcher and Mayor John Tory on what's coming to East York and Toronto in 2021
records.source_quote: Join me this Sunday at 12pm for a conversation with Councillor @paulafletcher and Mayor @johntory on what's coming to East York and Toronto in 2021!

records.summary: States that continued focus and intergovernmental cooperation are needed during vaccine rollout.
records.source_quote: This is a moment of hope - but we can't lose focus. There is lots of work in the months ahead, and we need all levels of government working together.

records.event_label: Vaccination milestone at St. Clair O'Connor Community
records.topic_focus: COVID-19 vaccine rollout in long-term care homes
records.source_quote: Incredible moment at the St. Clair O'Connor Community today. With the needles in John and Beverley's arm, every resident in the 22 LTC homes in the @michaelgarronhospital network has been vaccinated!

records.summary: States that work moved forward on Destination Danforth in 2020.
records.source_quote: We moved forward with #destinationdanforth

records.source_quote: to ensure programs like ActiveTO become permanent 💪

records.summary: States that food banks make a significant difference in local communities by helping those experiencing hunger.
records.source_quote: Food banks make a huge difference in our local communities by helping those in hunger.

records.summary: States that focus needs to remain on prevention as the community begins to round the corner on COVID-19.
records.source_quote: We are beginning to round the corner - but focus needs to remain on prevention. Stay safe this holiday season

records.summary: States the TTC weathered the pandemic ridership drop without major service cuts and without raising fares for 2021.
records.source_quote: We've weathered that storm without resorting to major service cuts and, as announced earlier this week, without raising fares for 2021.

records.summary: States surface transit will be vital to supporting local communities and transit system recovery.
records.source_quote: Ridership data continues to show us how vital surface transit will be to supporting our local communities and our transit system through recovery.

records.summary: Supports RapidTO Bus Priority Lanes as improving the network and saving time for essential workers.
records.source_quote: Initiatives like the RapidTO Bus Priority Lanes help improve our network and give valuable minutes back each day to countless essential workers.

records.summary: States public consultation is critical and that under-represented and under-consulted communities need to be engaged.
records.source_quote: We need to engage with the under-represented and under-consulted communities to ensure that we're getting things right.

records.summary: TTC froze fares for 2021 and avoided major service cuts during the pandemic.
records.source_quote: as announced earlier this week, without raising fares for 2021

records.summary: Supports freezing TTC fares for 2021 to keep transit affordable and help restore ridership.
records.source_quote: Freezing fares for 2021 is the right move to keep the #TTC affordable for folks and help to bring ridership back.

records.summary: States cooperation across levels of government helped avoid significant TTC service cuts or fare increases.
records.source_quote: Great to see cooperation from all levels of government to avoid significant service cuts or fare increases after an incredibly difficult year.

records.summary: Supports the vacant home tax as a tool to improve housing affordability and availability in Toronto.
records.source_quote: Great news for housing opportunity in Toronto as City Council votes to advance a vacant home tax today.

records.summary: States that pressures on Toronto rental housing will re-emerge in coming months and years despite recent market shifts.
records.source_quote: The market may have shifted a few degrees over the past few months, but the fundamentals that have made Toronto an extremely attractive place to live, work and invest still remain - and those pressures on rental housing will re-emerge in the months and years ahead.

records.summary: States no single policy is a complete solution but Toronto must continue developing tools for affordability and accessibility.
records.source_quote: No one policy tool is the be-all, end-all solution, but it's important that Toronto keeps developing the tools we need to make Toronto a more accessible and affordable place to live.

records.summary: City Council voted to advance a vacant home tax in Toronto.
records.source_quote: City Council votes to advance a vacant home tax today

records.summary: States that addressing systemic racism within the TTC and City services requires consistent effort, strategic planning, and accountability over years.
records.source_quote: Consistent effort, strategic planning, and accountability will help us drive this critical issue forward. It will take years to undo the legacies of systemic racism and discrimination within our City services.

records.summary: States that communicating updates to customers and Torontonians will be key to continued dialog and real change as the TTC does anti-racism work.
records.source_quote: As the TTC conducts this work, communicating updates with our customers and Torontonians will be key to continued dialog and real change.

records.summary: At a TTC Board meeting, putting in place a 10 point plan and 5 year strategy to help address systemic racism.
records.source_quote: At today's Board meeting we are putting in place a 10 point plan and 5 year strategy to help address systemic racism.

records.summary: Asked the TTC to report back on any additional resources needed to implement measures addressing anti-Black racism and increasing inclusion.
records.source_quote: I've also asked the TTC to report back on any additional resources that will be needed to make sure we can implement these critical measures to address anti-Black racism and increase inclusion in the organization.

records.summary: Announces completion of Gledhill Park playground enhancements, including accessibility improvements.
records.source_quote: The Gledhill Park playground enhancements are complete!

records.event_label: Gledhill Park playground enhancements completion
records.source_quote: The Gledhill Park playground enhancements are complete!

records.summary: States that the environmental crisis is one of the greatest challenges facing the world and that a more sustainable economy should be built coming out of the pandemic.
records.source_quote: The environmental crisis is one of the greatest challenges facing our world and we need to build back a more sustainable economy coming out of the pandemic.

records.event_label: Conversation with the Holistic Sustainable Development Network
records.source_quote: Great conversation this afternoon with the Holistic Sustainable Development Network.

records.summary: States need to stay focused on prevention and protecting the health care system until a broader COVID-19 vaccine rollout is possible.
records.source_quote: We're rounding a corner, but need to stay focused on prevention and protecting our health care system until a more broad rollout is possible.

records.summary: States that a housing data strategy is critical for good policy implementation and strengthens the city's position when engaging other levels of government on funding.
records.source_quote: Another important step from PHC today on developing a housing data strategy. Critical for good implementation as the numbers will show us where policies will have the most impact. Also strengthen our position when we're engaging with other levels of government on funding.

records.summary: Notes a step taken at the Planning and Housing Committee (PHC) on developing a housing data strategy.
records.source_quote: Another important step from PHC today on developing a housing data strategy.

records.summary: States that increasing housing options, including garden suites, is crucial for families caring for aging loved ones and people starting out in the city.
records.source_quote: From families looking to care for loved ones as they age-in-place to folks just starting out in the City - increasing housing options is crucial.

records.summary: Supports moving ahead on Garden Suites as a new housing option for Toronto.
records.source_quote: Great to see Committee vote to move ahead on a new housing option for the city: Garden Suites.

records.summary: Moved a motion at Planning and Housing Committee to grandfather in existing unique dwellings (coach houses, granny flats, garden suites) as part of consultations and by-law updates.
records.source_quote: as we set out on consultations and by-law updates, I moved a motion to make sure we include a way to "grandfather in" the many unique dwellings that are already providing housing here in Toronto.

records.summary: Supports exploring new ways to allow Garden Suites across Toronto as a new housing option.
records.source_quote: The City is exploring new ways to allow Garden Suites across Toronto. Tomorrow is an important day - Planning and Housing Committee will vote on whether to move ahead on new housing options for the city.

records.summary: Encourages residents to submit comments to the Planning and Housing Committee on the Garden Suites proposal.
records.source_quote: Your input is crucial! Check the link in my bio for more info on how you can submit comments to the committee!

records.summary: States a vacant home tax is less about revenue and more about smart policy to curb housing speculation.
records.source_quote: introducing a  policy like this is less about generating revenue and more about smart policy to curb housing speculation.

records.summary: States that with 1% rental vacancy and high demand, returning vacant homes to the market contributes to affordability.
records.source_quote: With 1% rental vacancy & insatiable demand, every home back on the market contributes to affordability.

records.summary: States a well-designed vacant home tax can accommodate legitimate reasons a home might be vacant.
records.source_quote: A well-designed policy can address concerns where a home might be vacant for legitimate reasons.

records.summary: Notes Toronto can learn from Vancouver's experience with vacant home tax policies.
records.source_quote: Policies like this have been around for a few years in places like Vancouver, and we have an opportunity to learn and improve on their experience.

records.summary: States that distributed energy is a way to tackle the climate crisis.
records.source_quote: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers Of Ontario about the ways we the can tackle our climate crisis through distributed energy.

records.summary: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers of Ontario about tackling the climate crisis through distributed energy.

records.event_label: Address to the Association of Power Producers of Ontario
records.source_quote: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers Of Ontario about the ways we the can tackle our climate crisis through distributed energy.

records.summary: States Toronto has a winter recreation plan to keep residents physically and mentally healthy during COVID while staying safe.
records.source_quote: Did you know that Toronto has an incredible plan for making the most of this winter? A lot of winter rec programming starts today. With COVID affecting the season, we're finding ways to make the most of the cold and dark to keep ourselves physically and mentally healthy while staying safe.

records.summary: Announces City funding available for winter activations and lists winter amenities including toboggan hills, snow loops, outdoor rinks, disc golf, Walk Fit programs, and High Park car-free weekends.
records.source_quote: The City's also making funding available for winter activations so make sure to read on. ✅ 23 toboggan hills in neighbourhoods across Toronto ✅ 8 snow loops for walking and snowshoeing at the City's five golf courses

records.summary: Announces City will more than double its supply of winter park washrooms from 64 to 143 as part of COVID-19 response.
records.source_quote: The City will more than double its supply of winter park washrooms from 64 to 143 as part of its ongoing response to COVID-19

records.summary: Notes City is accepting applications until December 31 for community-built and maintained natural ice rinks in City parks.
records.source_quote: Up to 30-plus natural ice rinks – the City is accepting applications until December 31 for community-built and maintained natural ice rinks in City parks

records.summary: States there is an urgent need for affordable housing in Toronto.
records.source_quote: We have an urgent need for affordable housing in Toronto.

records.location: Queen & Coxwell, Toronto (virtual registration via createto.ca/1631queen)
records.source_quote: The @cityofto is redeveloping public lands for housing and other neighbourhood investments. Come give your input at the early stages of a proposal near Queen & Coxwell. Dec 7th, 7pm.

records.summary: States the Province has the power to implement an eviction moratorium and calls on it to act.
records.source_quote: The Province is the level of government with the power to implement this. They have been vocal about being partners and can now make a real difference for communities in this city by taking this important step.

records.summary: Supports halting residential and commercial evictions during the COVID-19 lockdown.
records.source_quote: City Council voted unanimously for my motion to stop residential & commercial evictions during this lockdown.

records.summary: Brought a motion at City Council to stop residential and commercial evictions during the lockdown; passed unanimously.
records.source_quote: Earlier today, City Council voted unanimously for my motion to stop residential & commercial evictions during this lockdown.

records.summary: States residents should wear masks and maintain distance from those outside their household during the COVID-19 lockdown.
records.source_quote: Stay safe, wear a mask, and keep your distance from folks outside of your household.

records.summary: States that going into lockdown is a major blow but the only choice to fight COVID long-term.
records.source_quote: Going into lockdown is a major blow but it's our only choice to fight this long-term.

records.summary: Supports reinstating the moratorium on evictions for families and small businesses.
records.source_quote: starting with reinstating the moratorium on evictions for families & small businesses

records.summary: States the Province can stop evictions and help people pay the rent.
records.source_quote: The Province can stop evictions for families and businesses, and help people pay the rent

records.summary: Supports Feds and Province doubling down on funding for heavily impacted sectors, especially health, wellness and fitness studios.
records.source_quote: The Feds and Province can double down on funding commitments for sectors that have been most heavily impacted, especially health, wellness and fitness studios to help them keep the lights on.

records.summary: Supports accelerating rollout of rapid transit network including bus priority corridors at the City level.
records.source_quote: accelerating roll-out of our rapid transit network like bus priority corridors (City)

records.summary: Supports addressing systemic policy issues like commercial tax assessments at City and Province levels.
records.source_quote: addressing systemic policy issues like commercial tax assessments (City and Province)

records.summary: States Feds, Provinces and Cities need to align with funding committed from levels of government best able to pay.
records.source_quote: Feds, Provinces and Cities need to align, and have funding committed from the levels of government that have the best ability to pay.

records.summary: States that getting outdoors for fresh air and sunlight will be crucial for mental and physical health during winter.
records.source_quote: Getting outdoors for fresh air and some sunlight will be crucial for our mental and physical health this winter.

records.summary: Supports doubling winter washroom access in city parks to facilitate continued safe outdoor use.
records.source_quote: The City's responding to advocacy from across the city and planning to double winter washroom access: 79 facilities in 64 locations will help us stay safe and healthy.

records.summary: City announced plan to double winter washroom access to 79 facilities in 64 locations in response to advocacy.
records.source_quote: The City's responding to advocacy from across the city and planning to double winter washroom access: 79 facilities in 64 locations will help us stay safe and healthy.

records.summary: States electric vehicles will play a critical role in meeting Toronto's emission goals.
records.source_quote: Electric vehicles will play a critical role in meeting our emission goals across the City.

records.summary: States the biggest barrier to EV ownership is lack of access to convenient charging stations.
records.source_quote: Recent studies have shown that the biggest barrier to EV ownership is a lack of access to convenient charging stations.

records.summary: States front yard parking pads could allow residents to charge EVs in front of their home, subject to existing environmental regulations.
records.source_quote: Front yard parking, or parking pads, would provide a place for folks to charge their vehicle right in front of their home. There are strict environmental regulations in place for front yard parking, with requirements for permeable paving materials and protecting trees.

records.summary: States the front yard parking application process is broken and is frequently circumvented through appeal boards.
records.source_quote: Unfortunately, the process to apply for front yard parking is broken. People frequently skirt around the process through appeal boards in order to achieve their desired outcome.

records.summary: Calls for a pragmatic approach to incentivize EV use in neighbourhoods.
records.source_quote: We need a pragmatic approach to incentivize EV use in our neighbourhoods.

records.summary: Unveiled an EV Charging Station pilot with 17 charging stations around Toronto.
records.source_quote: Recently we unveiled the EV Charging Station pilot with 17 charging stations around Toronto.

records.summary: States need to work with federal and provincial partners to support small businesses and help municipalities recover.
records.source_quote: Need to work with our federal and provincial partners to support our small businesses, protect our communities, and come back stronger.

records.event_label: FCM Ontario Caucus meeting
records.topic_focus: Municipal recovery, small business support, intergovernmental cooperation
records.source_quote: Meeting with the @fcmgram Ontario Caucus to discuss the road to recovery for our municipalities.

records.summary: States that the 2019 Danforth pop-up by 8 80 Cities helped lay the foundation for the summer 2020 Danforth transformation.
records.source_quote: 8 80 and many others helped lay the foundation for Danforth with the 2019 pop-up, supported by a generous private donor.

records.summary: States Toronto has a housing crisis and that multi-tenant homes play a crucial role in providing affordable housing.
records.source_quote: It's no secret that we have a housing crisis in Toronto. Multi-tenant homes have long played a crucial role in providing an affordable place to live, and we need to legitimize them across the city.

records.summary: Supports legitimizing multi-tenant homes city-wide and creating pathways to compliance to support housing supply and safety.
records.source_quote: Creating pathways to compliance supports our housing supply and creates a safer environment for our neighbours in these homes.

records.summary: States the city should keep public infrastructure clean to encourage outdoor activity during winter amid the pandemic.
records.source_quote: We need to incentivize folks to avoid indoor gatherings and get outside this winter. Keeping our infrastructure clean is a great place to start!

records.summary: States that residents can request road safety measures through their local councillor and invites ideas to make Beaches-East York the safest area in the city.
records.source_quote: Did you know that you can request road safety measures by reaching out to your local councillor? Share your ideas and let's make Beaches-East York the safest area in the City!

records.summary: States Dr. de Villa's decision to bring in more COVID-19 restrictions in Toronto is difficult but correct.
records.source_quote: Dr. de Villa is making the extremely difficult, but correct, decision to bring in more restrictions in Toronto, starting Saturday.

records.summary: States urgent support is needed for businesses facing further pressure from closures during the pandemic.
records.source_quote: These closures put even further pressure on businesses that have been struggling throughout the pandemic and urgent support is needed.

records.summary: Supports creating new commercial tax bands so neighbourhood stores aren't taxed the same as office towers.
records.source_quote: We need new commercial tax bands to prevent neighbourhood stores being taxed the same as an office tower.

records.summary: Supports further protection for commercial tenants against unscrupulous landlords.
records.source_quote: We need further protection for commercial tenants to protect against unscrupulous landlords.

records.summary: Supports City incentives for entrepreneurs through lower start-up costs.
records.source_quote: There are also opportunities for the City to incentivize entrepreneurs with lower start-up costs.

records.summary: States economic recovery will run through main street and small businesses must be protected through another lockdown.
records.source_quote: Our economic recovery will run through main street and we need to do everything we can to protect our mom-and-pops through another lockdown.

records.quote_text: Our economic recovery will run through main street and we need to do everything we can to protect our mom-and-pops through another lockdown.
records.speaker: Brad Bradford

records.summary: States Toronto is one of the most diverse cities in the world and the monument celebrates that diversity.
records.source_quote: We have one of the most diverse cities in the world, and this monument is a celebration of that diversity.

records.summary: Attended the groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument in Dentonia Park.
records.source_quote: This Saturday, we celebrated the groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument right here in Dentonia Park.

records.event_label: Groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument
records.source_quote: This Saturday, we celebrated the groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument right here in Dentonia Park.

records.summary: Announced an Electric Vehicle Charging pilot at Stephenson Park.
records.source_quote: Great morning at Stephenson Park announcing our Electric Vehicle Charging pilot!

records.event_label: Electric Vehicle Charging pilot announcement
records.source_quote: Great morning at Stephenson Park announcing our Electric Vehicle Charging pilot!

records.summary: States EVs will be important in meeting climate goals and convenient charging can incentivize adoption.
records.source_quote: We know how important EVs will be in meeting our climate goals, and introducing convenient charging options can help incentivize folks to make the switch.

records.summary: States Toronto needs to encourage residents to get out safely in winter, including by winterizing patios.
records.source_quote: This year in particular it's crucial that we encourage folks to get out in the city, safely. We need to embrace winter in a different way. Winterizing patios is one path we're moving forward on, but more is needed.

records.summary: Suggests winter park trails and indoor-outdoor spaces as ways to encourage people to get outside in winter.
records.source_quote: Winter parks trails and indoor-outdoor spaces are just some other examples how we can encourage folks to get out.

records.summary: States the city is moving forward on winterizing patios.
records.source_quote: Winterizing patios is one path we're moving forward on, but more is needed.

records.summary: States Winter Stations will help bring people out safely during a dark winter and draw visitors to the East End.
records.source_quote: This will be a particularly dark winter, and we need to do what we can to get folks out safely. @winter.stations will light up our community and bring visitors from across the City to see what the East End has to offer!

records.event_label: Winter Stations announcement / Global News interview with Susan Hay
records.source_quote: Great to chat with Susan Hay from @globalnewsto about what Winter Stations brings to the community!

records.summary: Notes the Cenotaph in Kew Gardens was recently updated to honour the 128 Canadians who lost their lives in Afghanistan peacekeeping efforts.
records.source_quote: the Cenotaph in Kew Gardens was updated recently to honour the 128 Canadians who lost their lives in Afghanistan peacekeeping efforts.

records.event_label: Virtual Remembrance Day ceremony live-stream
records.location: Kew Gardens / Beaches—East York (virtual via Instagram and Facebook)
records.topic_focus: Remembrance Day commemoration of Canadian veterans
records.source_quote: I’ll be live-streaming a Remembrance ceremony through Instagram and Facebook to honour those who made the ultimate sacrifice in defence of our freedoms. Join me at 11am next Wednesday, November 11th

records.pledge_text: Will live-stream a Remembrance Day ceremony on November 11th at 11am via Instagram and Facebook.
